```{r}
library(png)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
```


#read in intermediates
```{r}
#benchmarks
s3_b <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/3_supplementary/supp3/intermediates/s3_b.rds")
s3_c <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/3_supplementary/supp3/intermediates/s3_c.rds")

#A B C D
s3_a <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/3_supplementary/supp3/intermediates/s3_a.rds")
s3_d <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/3_supplementary/supp3/intermediates/s3_d.rds")
s3_e <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/3_supplementary/supp3/intermediates/s3_e.rds")
s3_f <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/3_supplementary/supp3/intermediates/s3_f.rds")

```


```{r}
s3_top_bench <- plot_grid(s3_b, s3_c, labels = c("b", "c"),
  label_size = 7, nrow = 2, ncol=1, hjust = 0, vjust = 1.0, rel_heights = c(1,0.8))
s3_top_bench
```


```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
s3_top <- plot_grid(s3_a, s3_top_bench, ncol=2, labels = c("a", ""), label_size = 7, hjust = 0, vjust = 1.0, rel_widths = c(0.8,1)) 
s3_top
```


```{r, fig.width=7}
s3_left <- plot_grid(s3_d, s3_e, s3_f, labels = c("d", "e", "f"),
  label_size = 7, nrow = 3, hjust = 0, vjust = 1.0)
```


```{r, fig.width=7.5}
s3_middle <- plot_grid(s3_d, s3_e, labels=c("d", "e"), label_size = 7, ncol = 2, hjust = 0, vjust = 1.0)
s3_middle
```



```{r, fig.width=7}
s3_bot <- plot_grid(s3_f, NULL, labels=c("f", ""), label_size = 7, ncol=2, rel_widths = c(0.9,0.8))
#s3_bot
```

```{r, fig.height=8, fig.width=7.5}
s3_complete <- plot_grid(s3_top, s3_middle, s3_bot, nrow=3, rel_heights = c(0.8, 0.3, 0.25))
s3_complete
```


```{r}
ggsave("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/1_full_pds/s3.pdf", plot=s3_complete, width = 7.5, height = 8)
ggsave("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/1_full_pds/s3.png", plot=s3_complete, width = 7.5, height = 8)
```
